newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains higher, but quiet ahead of tender.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains higher, but quiet ahead of tender.

text.p: UK cash grains were mostly higher but the market was quiet on Thursday ahead of the last weekly European Union grain tender before the Easter break.
"We have had some poor days recently, but has been the slowest yet," said one broker.
On the coaster market feed wheat prices were 0.50 to one stg up with April trading at 102 stg and Oct/Dec at 101.50 stg a tonne fob ex-east coast ports.
May feed wheat was offered 103.75 stg and bid 102.75 stg while new crop Sep was a seller at 96.75 with buyers at 97.50 stg a tonne.
In the delivered sector feed wheat was fetching 101.50 to 102 stg for March depending on area while July material in East Anglia was trading at 107 stg.
New crop feed barley fetched 99 stg for Oct/Dec and 102 stg for Jan/Mar in East Anglia.
No milling wheat busisness was reported.
